hero.headline: Stocks fell 2% for a sixth straight day. Here is how the slide reaches your 401(k).
hero.dek: Every story on FIOPO is traced to where it lands: your fuel, your rent, your savings, your job. Here is how today's biggest story travels.

chain.label: The event
chain.text: The Dow fell 1,101.11 points, or 2.19%, to 49,097.06 on Thursday. The S&P 500 lost 2.02% and the Nasdaq 2.25%. All 11 S&P sectors fell.

chain.label: The streak
chain.text: It was the S&P 500's sixth straight loss, its longest losing run since April 2024.

chain.label: The triggers
chain.text: AMD fell 7.72% after a Hunterbrook short report on its China ties. Investors also worried about AI spending, high valuations and a Fed that signals more rate hikes.

chain.label: Fear gauge
chain.text: The VIX volatility index jumped 15.8% to 28.44. Friday brought no relief: at 08:06 GMT Nasdaq 100 futures were down 0.7% and S&P 500 futures 0.4%.

chain.label: You
chain.text: Most 401(k) and IRA savers hold S&P 500 or total market funds, so they took this hit too. Six down days hurt, but selling after a drop locks in the loss.

hero.caption: Sources: Yahoo Finance and The Motley Fool November 19; The Rio Times November 20; Yahoo Finance November 20. The chain itself is FIOPO analysis.

stories.headline: Gas fell 18 cents in a week to $3.72. It may fall further before Thanksgiving.
stories.happened: The AAA national average was $3.72 on November 19, down from $3.91 a week earlier and $4.30 a month ago. It is still about 60 cents above a year ago. Prices are under $4 in 40 states.
stories.happening: US crude has slid into the low $80s and stockpiles rose 3.4 million barrels. AAA expects nearly 73 million people to take Thanksgiving road trips next week and says the average could drop another 15 cents by Thursday, avoiding a holiday record. The record is $3.58, set on Thanksgiving 2022.

could.text: Falling crude points to cheaper gas into the holiday. A flare up in the Gulf is the main risk to that.

you: Driving for Thanksgiving? Use a price app to compare stations. The gap within a few miles is often bigger than the weekly drop.
California averages $5.51 and Texas $3.21. If your route crosses state lines, fill up in the cheaper state.
Put the savings toward variable rate debt. The Fed still signals more rate hikes, and card rates follow.

stories.headline: Trump delays any decision on new Iran strikes until 2027. Oil heads for a third weekly drop.
stories.happened: Flying home from China on Thursday, Trump told Reuters he would discuss new strikes on Iran "after the beginning of the year" and told Axios, "I am not rushing into any decision." The Senate rejected a war powers resolution 48 to 51. The US naval blockade stays in place.
stories.happening: Brent traded at $92.22 in Asia on Friday, on course for a weekly fall of about 3.5%, its third in a row, as Gulf crude shipments recover. Houthi strikes damaged the PIF Tower in Riyadh's financial district, with no injuries reported. Iran's Revolutionary Guards say Hormuz will not fully reopen until the US meets their conditions.

could.note: FIOPO read for the next 30 days, unchanged from November 17. A delay is not a deal. Judgment, not fact.

you: A pause in US strikes lowers the near term risk to fuel prices. Pump prices are already falling.
Holding energy funds? Brent is down about 20% in November. Check that one sector is not a large share of your savings.
Flying through Gulf hubs? Keep bookings flexible. Houthi drones and missiles are still being intercepted over Saudi Arabia.

stories.headline: Anthropic jumped 34% at the open, then gave back half. It is lower again before Friday's bell.
stories.happened: Anthropic's first trade on the Nasdaq was $111.50, 34% above its $83 IPO price, with 108 million shares changing hands. It closed Thursday at $97.17, up 17.07%, on a day when the Nasdaq fell 2.25%.
stories.happening: ANT traded at $90.99 at 4:01 a.m. Eastern Friday, down 6.36% from Thursday's close but still above $83. Nvidia stopped shipping advanced AI chips to China, and Colette Kress cited $2.4 billion in quarterly China sales.

could.text: A small public float means big daily swings in both directions. Expect the price to stay volatile while the broader market looks for a floor.
could.note: FIOPO read. Judgment, not fact. Not investment advice.

you: Bought ANT on day one? Decide now what drop you would accept, and use limit orders rather than market orders.
Do not chase a first day pop. Set the price you are willing to pay and wait for it.
Own an S&P 500 fund? You already have exposure through Amazon and Google, both large outside holders.
stories.watch: where ANT trades versus its $83 IPO price.

stories.headline: Gold and Bitcoin fell with stocks. Bitcoin is near $60,000 as ETF money leaves.
stories.happened: Gold futures settled down 1.50% at $3,685.50 on Thursday. Bitcoin fell 2.15% to $61,635.18 by early evening. US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost more than $300 million on Wednesday, taking 2026 net outflows past $2.5 billion.
stories.happening: Gold was heading for a weekly drop of about 9% on Friday, its steepest in eight months, as the dollar sits near a 19 month high and the Fed signals more rate hikes.

could.text: When rates rise and the dollar is strong, assets that pay no interest tend to struggle. That pressure lasts as long as the Fed keeps hiking.
could.note: FIOPO read. Judgment, not fact. Not investment advice.

you: Gold and crypto did not cushion this selloff. Do not count on them as your only safety net.
For money you need within a year, insured savings and Treasury bills now pay near the Fed rate.
Keep any crypto to a share of savings you could lose without changing your plans.
stories.watch: Bitcoin around $60,000 and the Fed on December 9.

regions.covers: China, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Southeast Asia
regions.headline: China's shoppers pulled back hard in October.
regions.text: Retail sales grew just 0.4% from a year earlier, down from 1.1% in September, and car sales fell 27.1%. Consumer prices rose 0.7%. Exports, by contrast, jumped 35.2% to $412.33 billion.
regions.you: Weak demand at home pushes Chinese factories to sell abroad. Expect plenty of low priced Chinese goods, and more trade friction over them.

regions.covers: India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal
regions.headline: The rupee hits a seven month high on foreign buying.
regions.text: The rupee settled at 93.30 per dollar on Thursday, its fourth straight gain. Foreign investors have put more than ₹88,000 crore into Indian stocks in November, the fastest monthly pace since November 2020.
regions.you: Sending dollars to India? Each dollar buys a little less than last week. Paying Indian suppliers in rupees costs a bit more.

regions.covers: European Union, United Kingdom, Ukraine, Russia
regions.headline: UK inflation edges up to 3.6%.
regions.text: Britain's statistics office said inflation rose to 3.6% in October from 3.5%, a touch below the 3.7% forecast. UK and EU leaders hold a summit in Brussels on Friday.
regions.you: Planning a UK trip or paying UK bills? Prices are still rising well above the Bank of England's 2% goal, which keeps UK rates high.

regions.covers: Gulf states, Iran, Israel, Iraq, Yemen
regions.headline: Houthi strikes damage the PIF Tower in Riyadh.
regions.text: Saudi Civil Defence said the attack damaged the headquarters of the kingdom's sovereign wealth fund in the King Abdullah Financial District. No injuries were reported. The UAE, Qatar, Kuwait and the GCC condemned it.
regions.you: Traveling to or through Saudi Arabia? Check airline and embassy alerts before you go.

regions.covers: Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya, DR Congo, Ethiopia, Egypt
regions.headline: Nigeria's inflation hits a six year low, but cooking gas is up.
regions.text: Inflation fell to 14.06% in October. Cooking gas now costs ₦1,600 to ₦1,800 per kg in several cities, against about ₦1,400 a month ago, and some households are turning back to charcoal. The central bank meets November 23 to 24 with its rate at 23%.
regions.you: Sending money to Nigeria? The naira was ₦1,363 per dollar on November 18. Household fuel is eating into what remittances buy.

regions.headline: Brazil's real and Argentina's peso slide as Wall Street sells off.
regions.text: The real fell to 5.93 per dollar, its weakest since April 2025. Argentina's peso weakened to 1,565 per dollar, its weakest close in at least 12 months, and the Merval fell 0.96%.
regions.you: A trip to Brazil or Argentina is getting cheaper in dollars. Locals there pay more for imported goods.

sports.headline: LIV Golf is winding down after Saudi Arabia's wealth fund stops paying.
sports.text: Front Office Sports reports the league was backed by more than $5 billion from the Public Investment Fund. With that funding ending, stars are leaving and events are being canceled.
sports.you: Holding tickets for a LIV event? Check refund terms now and pay with a card that offers chargeback protection.

sources.name: Front Office Sports via Yahoo Sports

sports.headline: Brazil's football federation suspends a regional cup as betting limits hit sponsors.
sports.text: The CBF suspended the South-Southeast Cup for 2027 after betting restrictions disrupted sponsorship talks. It forecasts a R$420 million revenue shortfall next year. Separately, Mercado Libre renewed its CONMEBOL club sponsorship through 2030.
sports.you: Betting sponsors fund much of global sport. Rule changes on gambling can quickly shrink schedules and raise ticket prices.

sports.headline: Infantino faces two challengers for the FIFA presidency.
sports.text: FIFA received three nominations: Gianni Infantino, France's Philippe Diallo and Japan's Kohzo Tashima. Checks on eligibility come first. The vote is at the FIFA Congress in Rabat on March 18, 2027.
sports.you: FIFA's leader shapes World Cup ticket pricing and TV deals. Watch the campaign if you plan to attend 2030 matches.

entertainment.headline: 2026 is India's biggest box office year ever, with 45 days to go.
entertainment.text: Indian cinemas grossed ₹13,775 crore through November 15, already ₹425 crore more than all of 2025, per Sacnilk estimates. Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge leads with ₹1,375 crore, ahead of Ramayana at ₹909 crore.
entertainment.you: Indian films now open widely in US theaters. Check local listings, since tickets for big releases sell fast on opening weekend.

entertainment.headline: Marvel's Avengers: Doomsday trailer is trending ahead of a December 18 release.
entertainment.text: The trailer had 6.5 million views and ranked second on YouTube's US trending list on November 20. The film opens in theaters December 18.
entertainment.you: Big holiday releases often sell premium formats out early. Book opening weekend seats ahead if you want IMAX.

items.text: IShowSpeed's GTA 6 early access stream has 63 million views. GTA 6 videos fill several top 20 spots.
Rajshri's trailer for Yeh Prem Mol Liya has 33 million views in two days.
Taylor Swift's live CMA Awards performance is the top trending video.

innovation.headline: A new material captures carbon even from humid exhaust.
innovation.text: Oregon State University chemists built BVR-X, a metal-organic framework that keeps water and CO2 apart in its pores. It captured CO2 from a humid gas with only 4% CO2 and kept working over dozens of cycles. A patent has been filed.
innovation.you: Humidity is a big cost in carbon capture. Cheaper capture could matter for power and industrial bills over time.

innovation.headline: Citi warns customers they may be liable for what AI agents do in their accounts.
innovation.text: Citi told customers they may be responsible for actions taken by third party AI tools they give account access to. TechCrunch reports more banks are taking the same line.
innovation.you: Do not hand bank logins to AI assistants. Read your bank's terms before letting any tool move money.

innovation.headline: OpenAI says its models helped redesign a chip.
innovation.text: OpenAI said its models worked on chip design with AMD. One redesign cut estimated chip area about 15% and a calculation from two clock cycles to one.
innovation.you: Smaller chips can mean cheaper AI services. Watch for price cuts on AI tools you pay for.

travel.headline: Tsavo, Kenya: big elephant herds with fewer crowds.
travel.text: Lonely Planet named Tsavo East and West to its Best in Travel 2027 list for wide red earth savannahs and large elephant herds, with fewer visitors than Kenya's famous parks.
travel.you: CDC rates Kenya at Level 1, usual precautions, despite the regional Ebola outbreak. Check the notice again before you book.

image.alt: Wide savanna in Tsavo East National Park with elephants and giraffes

travel.headline: California's redwood coast, picked for 2027.
travel.text: Lonely Planet's 2027 list includes the Northern California coast and redwoods. Redwood National and State Parks protect some of the tallest trees on earth along 40 miles of Pacific coast.
travel.you: Check the official park site for fees, closures and road conditions before you go.

image.alt: Old growth coast redwoods in fog

travel.headline: Book holiday flights before a possible fuel spike.
travel.text: Oil is falling, but our 30 day read still gives a 25% chance Brent spikes above $100. Airfares follow fuel within weeks. The dollar also buys more in Brazil than at any time in a year.
travel.you: Lock in fares you are happy with now. FIOPO read, judgment not fact.

picks.title: What Should My Children Do?
picks.text: An economist asks what the next generation should learn, and what it should stop worrying about, in a world changed by AI. Useful for any family planning school or career choices.

picks.title: Primetime Preacher$
picks.text: A 113 minute film on Jim Bakker, Jerry Falwell and Jimmy Swaggart, three 1980s televangelists who built TV ministries before scandal. A sharp look at how money flows when trust is the product.

items.text: SpaceX caught a returning Starship upper stage with its launch tower arms for the first time, after 14 orbits. The booster was lost over the Gulf.
India won its first ODI cricket series in New Zealand in seven years, 3 to 1.
India beat Pakistan by one wicket to win the Under-19 Asia Cup, its ninth title.
NASA's Voyager 1 reached one light-day from Earth.
BepiColombo is entering orbit around Mercury, only the second spacecraft ever to do so.
ESA's Hera is arriving at the asteroid Didymos to study the crater from NASA's DART impact.
Artemis II splashed down off San Diego after a 10 day trip around the Moon, the first crewed lunar voyage in more than 50 years.
NASA's Perseverance set the record for distance driven on another world, more than 45 km on Mars.
The Hubble Space Telescope completed its 200,000th orbit of Earth.
